svg.title: 派蒙立绘临摹 · SVG 线稿
svg.desc: 参考 Creative Uncut 收录的原神派蒙立绘，以贝塞尔路径临摹轮廓。双手向前，椭圆光环、短发、宽袖、三环胸饰、披风及长靴。原角色版权归原权利人。
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.creativeuncut.com/gallery-39/gi-paimon.html ; image: https://www.creativeuncut.com/gallery-39/art/gi-paimon.jpg ; accessed: 2026-10-10 ; reference SHA-256: 7a8f3dee496cb5f81d1e04235eee4bc2bbff16a833512bf7ca174df9f04ac4c9 . Hand-drawn vector study; no embedded bitmap.
